response.hypothesis: The pudding configuration and pudding-first order are retained because its placement predicate succeeded consistently. The latest failure was exclusively the mug approach: dz=0.116 was approximately 0.27 mm inside the feasibility boundary. The earlier dz=0.120 grasp was feasible but too shallow to retain the mug and caused outer-finger contact. I therefore changed only the mug grasp dz to 0.117, just above the measured feasibility boundary and 3 mm deeper than the non-retaining grasp. This should preserve approach feasibility while placing the mug wall farther onto the inner finger pads so it is carried to the already geometry-valid plate placement.

objects.derivation: Unchanged because all development runs completed its stages and satisfied its predicate. With site yaw 0 and pudding footprint 0.0802 by 0.0463 m, the collision center at world y=0.1+0.045=0.145 puts the plate-facing edge at 0.145-0.0463/2=0.12185 m, 0.04655 m beyond the plate edge y=0.0753. The 0.003 m tolerance leaves at least 0.04355 m nominal clearance and keeps the resulting origin below the accepted y maximum 0.15; observed final origins were y=0.1447-0.1449. The table-supported collision-center z is 0.4368+0.0274/2=0.4505, or 0.0405 m above site z=0.41, so place_dz 0.042 gives about a 0.0015 m drop and repeatedly produced z=0.4498 inside the accepted open interval (0.412,0.517). Transport at z=0.41+0.12=0.53 keeps the bottom near 0.53-0.0131=0.5169, above the plate top z=0.4557.

Only the mug grasp height is changed. The centered yaw-10.3 candidate at dz=0.116 was rejected with at-grasp clearance about -0.00027 m in every init, whereas dz=0.120 was feasible with about +0.00255 m but grasped too high: the mug never left its start pose and three runs reported outer-face right-finger contact. Linear interpolation places zero clearance at 0.116+0.00027/(0.00027+0.00255)*0.004=0.11638 m. Choosing dz=0.117 predicts about +0.00044 m clearance while lowering the fingers 0.003 m relative to the non-retaining dz=0.120 grasp, increasing inner-pad engagement. The mug top is 0.5428-0.4344=0.1084 m above its origin, so the hand reference is 0.117-0.1084=0.0086 m above the rim. Placement remains centered on the plate, giving zero nominal xy error with 0.006 m tolerance versus the required radius of 0.03 m. The plate top is z=0.4557 and the mug collision bottom is 0.0024 m above its origin, so its supported origin is 0.4557-0.0024=0.4533, or 0.0140 m above the plate origin z=0.4393; place_dz 0.0155 gives a 0.0015 m drop. Lift and transport origins are 0.4344+0.15=0.5844 and 0.4393+0.15=0.5893.
